name: Risk-on liquidity gate (stablecoin supply + DeFi TVL) on a range breakout (BTC/ETH)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from the trend-sleeve gate: this pairs the stablecoin regime with a SECOND liquidity confirmer — defi_tvl rising — and gates a range-BREAKOUT entry rather than a momentum-trend entry, so the regime conditions a different base signal): risk-on in crypto shows up as BOTH stablecoin supply expanding (fresh fiat in the perimeter) AND DeFi TVL rising (that capital being put to work on-chain). Requiring both filters out the 'stables minted but sitting idle' false risk-on. When both confirm, a price pushing to the top of its recent range (range_position high) is a genuine risk-on breakout rather than a chop-driven poke. The edge is only taking breakouts inside a confirmed liquidity-expansion regime, cutting the false-breakout drawdowns. DISCONFIRMER 1: the dual gate must improve DSR and cut maxDD vs an ungated breakout — else it is curve-fit. DISCONFIRMER 2: TVL is partly ETH-denominated so its rise can be disguised beta; if removing defi_tvl leaves the result unchanged the TVL leg adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 3: if a plain realized-vol regime filter matches it, the on-chain features are redundant. Net of fees, DSR>=0.95.
catalyst: dual on-chain liquidity expansion gating a range breakout
